user.title: Add a Toque robot
user.description: Switch on the home link on the robot first: Toque › Settings › Home link. The address of the robot is shown on that screen.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the robot on your home network.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description: On the robot ({host}), open Toque › Settings › Home link › Pair a device, then enter the 6-digit code shown on its screen. The code is valid for 5 minutes.

data_description.code: The 6 digits shown on the robot.

error.cannot_connect: The robot does not answer. Check that it is switched on, that the home link is enabled and that the address is right.
error.not_toque: Something answers at this address, but it is not a Toque home link.
error.invalid_code: The code is made of 6 digits.
error.bad_code: Wrong code. Check the code shown on the robot and try again.
error.pairing_closed: No pairing code is on screen. On the robot, open Settings › Home link › Pair a device.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong codes: this code was cancelled. Show a new code on the robot and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.wrong_device: The robot at this address is not the one that was configured. Remove the integration and add it again.

search_recipes.name: Search recipes
search_recipes.description: Searches the robot's recipe library and returns the matching recipes.

query.name: Search text
query.description: Words to look for. Empty: all recipes, favourites first.

category.name: Category
category.description: Keep one category only, by its name as shown on the robot.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of recipes returned (1 to 200).

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Number of recipes to skip, to read the next page.

config_entry_id.name: Robot
config_entry_id.description: Which robot to ask. Only needed when several robots are configured.

device_id.name: Robot (device)
device_id.description: Another way to say which robot: its device.

get_recipe.name: Get recipe
get_recipe.description: Returns one whole recipe: ingredients and steps.

recipe_id.name: Recipe ID
recipe_id.description: The id of the recipe, as returned by the recipe search.

config_entry_id.name: Robot
config_entry_id.description: Which robot to ask. Only needed when several robots are configured.

device_id.name: Robot (device)
device_id.description: Another way to say which robot: its device.

add_to_shopping_list.name: Add to shopping list
add_to_shopping_list.description: Adds the ingredients of one or several recipes to a to-do list, one item per ingredient.

recipe_id.name: Recipe ID
recipe_id.description: The id of a recipe, or a list of ids.

recipe_ids.name: Recipe IDs
recipe_ids.description: A list of recipe ids, as an alternative to the single id.

todo_entity.name: To-do list
todo_entity.description: The to-do list that receives the ingredients.

config_entry_id.name: Robot
config_entry_id.description: Which robot to ask. Only needed when several robots are configured.

device_id.name: Robot (device)
device_id.description: Another way to say which robot: its device.

no_robot.message: No Toque robot is set up and loaded.

robot_required.message: Several Toque robots are configured: say which one with config_entry_id or device_id.

robot_not_found.message: This robot is not a loaded Toque robot.

cannot_connect.message: The robot does not answer. It is probably switched off.

auth_failed.message: The robot refused the token. Pair Home Assistant with the robot again.

recipe_not_found.message: The robot has no recipe with the id {recipe_id}.

todo_unavailable.message: The to-do integration is not loaded: there is no list to add to.
